title: Sailpoint Developer
description:
Job Title: SailPoint Developer


Job Location

Remote / Hybrid / Onsite (as applicable)


Experience

6–10+ years overall IAM experience

4–8+ years hands-on SailPoint development


Job Description Summary

We are seeking a SailPoint Developer with strong hands-on experience in designing, developing, and implementing Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions using SailPoint (IdentityIQ and/or IdentityNow). The role is focused on custom development, integrations, workflows, and automation , not platform administration or access provisioning support.

The ideal candidate will work closely with security, application, and infrastructure teams to deliver scalable IAM solutions aligned with enterprise security and compliance requirements.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement SailPoint IAM solutions (IdentityIQ and/or IdentityNow)
  • Develop and customize workflows, rules, connectors, and lifecycle events
  • Build and maintain custom integrations between SailPoint and target systems (REST, SOAP, JDBC, LDAP, AD, Azure AD, etc.)
  • Develop custom provisioning logic , aggregation rules, and identity correlation logic
  • Implement access request, approval, and certification processes
  • Customize SailPoint UI components, forms, and reports as required
  • Develop and maintain policies, roles, entitlements, and governance models
  • Support user lifecycle management (Joiner–Mover–Leaver)
  • Perform unit testing, debugging, and performance tuning of SailPoint solutions
  • Participate in IAM solution design discussions and technical architecture reviews
  • Provide technical documentation and knowledge transfer
  • Collaborate with DevOps and security teams for deployments and upgrades
  • Support SailPoint upgrades and migrations (e.g., IIQ versions or IIQ → IdentityNow)


Required Technical Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience with SailPoint IdentityIQ and/or IdentityNow
  • Proficiency in Java, BeanShell, JavaScript
  • Experience developing SailPoint rules (Aggregation, Provisioning, Correlation, Validation, Certification)
  • Strong experience with SailPoint workflows
  • Experience with REST/SOAP APIs , JSON, XML
  • Knowledge of IAM concepts : authentication, authorization, RBAC, access governance
  • Experience integrating with:
  • Active Directory / Azure AD
  • LDAP
  • Databases (JDBC)
  • Cloud and enterprise applications
  • Understanding of certifications, access reviews, SoD policies
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments


Nice-to-Have Skills

  • SailPoint certifications (IdentityIQ Engineer, IdentityNow Engineer)
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Experience with DevOps tools (Git, Jenkins, CI/CD)
  • Knowledge of security standards (ISO 27001, SOX, GDPR)
  • Experience with PAM integrations (CyberArk, BeyondTrust)
  • Scripting knowledge (Python, PowerShell)


What This Role Is NOT

  • ❌ Not a SailPoint Administrator role
  • ❌ Not limited to user provisioning or access requests
  • ❌ Not a helpdesk or L2/L3 IAM support role


This is a core SailPoint development and engineering role .


Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Good communication and documentation skills
  • Ability to work independently and with cross-functional teams
  • Security-first mindset

title: AWS-Python Production Support Enginner
description:
AWS-Python Production Support Engineer


Language: Portuguese & English

Position: Full Remote

Experience: Seniority Level

Key Responsibilities

  • Troubleshoot and resolve delivery issues across environments, including pipeline failures and data inconsistencies.
  • Maintain and evolve schema-driven YAML/JSON configurations for distribution and exhibition platforms.
  • Support operational workflows by updating internal Python automation scripts.
  • Perform database-level investigations to validate data integrity and confirm fixes.
  • Work through PR-based change management with clear documentation and regression verification.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth delivery operations.
  • Apply observability and log analysis techniques to trace failures and extract actionable insights.
  • Ensure compliance with schema validation and maintain configuration hygiene.


Mandatory Knowledge

  • YAML/JSON (production-grade): Safe authoring/refactoring, strict structure, and change hygiene.
  • Git + PR workflow: Clean diffs, review discipline, conflict handling, and controlled promotions.
  • Observability & log analysis: Tracing failures across pipeline stages, correlating identifiers, and extracting actionable signals from logs/metrics.
  • Schema/validation mindset: Interpreting schema/tooling errors and keeping configs compliant.
  • Python: Debugging and adjusting existing scripts/automation; implementing targeted fixes safely.
  • Databases (SQL): Querying to investigate production issues, validate data integrity, and confirm outcomes.
  • Production support fundamentals: Incident triage, root-cause analysis, mitigations, and regression verification.
  • Jinja templating: Understanding template-driven generation and making safe, minimal changes.


Optional Knowledge

  • Media Supply Chain fundamentals: Deliverables, packaging concepts, metadata hierarchies, locale conventions, and downstream dependency impacts.
  • Advanced mapping/config patterns (conditional/switch/lookup/padding; robust globals/locals usage).
  • CI/automation improvements (linting/formatting, pre-validation checks, regression harnesses).
  • Partner operations context (common rejection patterns, partner-specific exceptions, operational playbooks).
  • Communication in incident/PR contexts (concise updates, change summaries, and requirement translation).


Preferred Experience

  • Hands-on experience in production support for large-scale delivery platforms.
  • Strong understanding of schema-driven configuration management and automation workflows.

title: Data Specialist
description:
About YipitData:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


About the Role:

We currently have 90+ Data team members who create and maintain our data products and we are looking to further expand the team to continue to increase our product portfolio. Those with strong analytical skills are encouraged to apply.

At YipitData, we value ownership and impact. While nearly everyone enters the Data Specialist position at the same level, starting compensation is based on years of relevant experience. Our career ladder also rewards strong performance with frequent opportunities to grow compensation and achieve promotions.

See this short video to learn more about our organization, product, and why some of our current Data Specialists love working here!


In this role, you will:

  • Be the primary owner of high-impact work such as running or building new data products end-to-end, running centralized data ingestion pipelines that the broader Data team relies on, or building clean granular data feeds that help clients dive into data.
  • Work with massive amounts of data to help answer our clients’ key questions about the companies we cover and the datasets we analyze. You will learn about our proprietary methods and techniques to ensure data accuracy and derive key insights.
  • Become a trusted and reliable resource for our internal stakeholders or clients and work with them to identify and answer their key questions. You’ll gain insight into how investors use data in their investment decisions by contributing to data feeds, custom analysis, or data reports that are consumed by the top investors in the world. If you join one of our Central Data teams, you’ll also learn how our data drives decision-making at some of the largest companies in the world.
  • Improve our products, data pipelines, or data feeds by developing entirely new methodologies and features for our products, exploring and scaling use across the data team of new third-party datasets, or creating new modules to make our raw feeds data experience better. We value self-improvement and experimentation and expect you to enhance the products, pipelines, or data feeds that you own.
  • Learn or sharpen existing SQL and Python skills starting with our two-month new hire training program that will teach you SQL, PySpark, and Python fundamentals as well as our internal tools and processes.


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You have a strong ownership mentality and want to ensure our products are the best in the world
  • You have strong attention to detail
  • You are a methodical problem-solver
  • You can clearly communicate complex concepts, both orally and in writing
  • You strive to make tasks as efficient as possible
  • You have an ability to manage multiple priorities
  • You are experimental and curious – you aren’t afraid of changing the status quo
  • You are enthusiastic about making a big impact at a rapidly growing company


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.


For You:

  • You’ll work with a New York-based team
  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Colombia/Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

title: Creative Project Manager
description:
About the Product

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose

The Creative Project Manager orchestrates strategic brand and creative initiatives that drive institutional brand equity and enrollment outcomes while maintaining fiscal responsibility for project profitability and creative team accountability. This role combines project management expertise with creative strategy understanding to deliver compelling, measurable brand solutions within the higher education space and consistency across creative deliverables provided by Carnegie.


Duties and Responsibilities

  • Strategic Project Leadership & Brand Outcome Management
  • Lead comprehensive project planning for brand and creative initiatives, establishing clear milestone maps that connect creative deliverables to client brand and enrollment objectives
  • Coordinate Subject Matter Expert (SME) resourcing across creative, content, multimedia, and brand strategy teams to optimize creative outcomes in partnership with Client Operations
  • Proactively assess and mitigate creative project risks, including resource constraints, approval bottlenecks, and brand compliance challenges, escalating issues to the Project Lead or Account Director to ensure proactive resolution and sustained client retention
  • Hold creative teams accountable for brand adherence, quality standards, and deliverable excellence through structured review processes
  • Financial Management & Resource Optimization
  • Track project revenue performance and burn rate to ensure creative projects remain profitable and within approved budgets
  • Monitor creative resource allocation and make real-time adjustments to optimize team utilization and creative project efficiency
  • Collaborate with finance and operations teams to maintain accurate forecasting
  • Cross-Solution Integration & Creative Workflow Leadership
  • Maintain strategic awareness of creative project integration points across solution project management campaigns to ensure brand consistency across all touchpoints
  • Collaborate with other solution PMs and the Project Lead to coordinate creative asset development timelines and shared brand resource requirements
  • Escalate creative integration challenges and brand compliance obstacles to Delivery Operations team for rapid resolution
  • Participate in cross-functional planning sessions to align creative initiatives with broader client marketing and brand strategies
  • Advanced Workflow Management & Quality Assurance
  • Manage Asana workflows for creative project management, including approval processes, version control, and comprehensive asset management systems
  • Implement and uphold creative quality assurance standards that exceed client brand expectations and industry benchmarks
  • Develop comprehensive creative brief and project documentation systems that ensure stakeholder alignment and creative accountability
  • Facilitate strategic client communications regarding creative strategy, brand development progress, and creative campaign performance insights


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Understanding of brand strategy, visual identity systems, and creative campaign development to guide strategic creative approaches
  • Proficiency with creative workflow management, brand guideline implementation, and creative quality control processes
  • Experience in project management methodologies with the ability to adapt approaches for diverse creative workflows and brand requirements
  • Advanced Asana administration, including creative-specific automation, approval workflows, and sophisticated asset management systems
  • Understanding of creative project P&L management and creative budget forecasting to maintain fiscal responsibility and profitability
  • Knowledge of multimedia production, content strategy, and cross-channel creative campaign coordination
  • Experience with brand performance measurement, creative testing methodologies, and brand equity assessment tools
  • Proven ability to manage multiple creative projects simultaneously while maintaining brand consistency, quality standards, and team accountability
  • Strong collaborator, skilled at aligning strategists and creative teams, fostering open communication between platforms and specialists
  • Dexterity and wherewithal to effectively deal with campaign pivots, platform changes, and continuous optimization requirements
  • Demonstrates initiative and autonomy, effectively managing priorities while utilizing guidance and support when appropriate
  • Experience or interest in using AI tools, with a willingness to learn how AI can impact and appropriately enhance the client experience
  • Due to the remote environment, effective communication and time management skills are required, as well as the ability to use/learn multiple technology platforms and switch between them on a regular basis
  • Physical requirement: Must be able to work at a computer for prolonged periods


Credentials and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Graphic Design, Project Management, or related field, or equivalent life/work experience
  • 3-5 years of project management experience with increasing responsibility, including a minimum of 2 years in creative project management
  • Demonstrated experience managing brand, creative, or multimedia projects in professional services or higher education environments
  • Higher education or creative agency experience strongly preferred
  • PMP, Agile, or equivalent project management certification preferred


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

title: Sailpoint Developer
description:
Job Title: SailPoint Developer


Job Location

Remote / Hybrid / Onsite (as applicable)


Experience

6–10+ years overall IAM experience

4–8+ years hands-on SailPoint development


Job Description Summary

We are seeking a SailPoint Developer with strong hands-on experience in designing, developing, and implementing Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions using SailPoint (IdentityIQ and/or IdentityNow). The role is focused on custom development, integrations, workflows, and automation , not platform administration or access provisioning support.

The ideal candidate will work closely with security, application, and infrastructure teams to deliver scalable IAM solutions aligned with enterprise security and compliance requirements.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement SailPoint IAM solutions (IdentityIQ and/or IdentityNow)
  • Develop and customize workflows, rules, connectors, and lifecycle events
  • Build and maintain custom integrations between SailPoint and target systems (REST, SOAP, JDBC, LDAP, AD, Azure AD, etc.)
  • Develop custom provisioning logic , aggregation rules, and identity correlation logic
  • Implement access request, approval, and certification processes
  • Customize SailPoint UI components, forms, and reports as required
  • Develop and maintain policies, roles, entitlements, and governance models
  • Support user lifecycle management (Joiner–Mover–Leaver)
  • Perform unit testing, debugging, and performance tuning of SailPoint solutions
  • Participate in IAM solution design discussions and technical architecture reviews
  • Provide technical documentation and knowledge transfer
  • Collaborate with DevOps and security teams for deployments and upgrades
  • Support SailPoint upgrades and migrations (e.g., IIQ versions or IIQ → IdentityNow)


Required Technical Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience with SailPoint IdentityIQ and/or IdentityNow
  • Proficiency in Java, BeanShell, JavaScript
  • Experience developing SailPoint rules (Aggregation, Provisioning, Correlation, Validation, Certification)
  • Strong experience with SailPoint workflows
  • Experience with REST/SOAP APIs , JSON, XML
  • Knowledge of IAM concepts : authentication, authorization, RBAC, access governance
  • Experience integrating with:
  • Active Directory / Azure AD
  • LDAP
  • Databases (JDBC)
  • Cloud and enterprise applications
  • Understanding of certifications, access reviews, SoD policies
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments


Nice-to-Have Skills

  • SailPoint certifications (IdentityIQ Engineer, IdentityNow Engineer)
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Experience with DevOps tools (Git, Jenkins, CI/CD)
  • Knowledge of security standards (ISO 27001, SOX, GDPR)
  • Experience with PAM integrations (CyberArk, BeyondTrust)
  • Scripting knowledge (Python, PowerShell)


What This Role Is NOT

  • ❌ Not a SailPoint Administrator role
  • ❌ Not limited to user provisioning or access requests
  • ❌ Not a helpdesk or L2/L3 IAM support role


This is a core SailPoint development and engineering role .


Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Good communication and documentation skills
  • Ability to work independently and with cross-functional teams
  • Security-first mindset

title: Tech Lead Plataforma e SRE
description:
O Mercado Eletrônico é líder na América Latina em soluções de gestão de compras B2B. Suas tecnologias e serviços para as áreas de compras ajudam empresas a conquistarem mais economia, agilidade, governança e colaboração.

Com escritórios no Brasil, Estados Unidos, México e Portugal, contabiliza mais de 1 milhão de fornecedores, 10 mil compradores e transaciona um valor acima de R$ 160 bilhões em negócios anualmente. É a única empresa latino-americana a fazer parte do Quadrante Mágico S2P (source-to-pay), do Gartner.


Tech Lead - Plataforma e SRE

contratação CLT


Gosta de desafios técnicos de alta complexidade, arquitetura escalável e resolver problemas de infraestrutura em escala? Aqui você vai liderar tecnicamente soluções em Kubernetes, observabilidade de ponta, automação e práticas modernas de SRE, garantindo alta disponibilidade e performance dos nossos sistemas.


Quais serão suas responsabilidades neste desafio?

  • Liderar tecnicamente a arquitetura e evolução da plataforma, definindo padrões e boas práticas de SRE e DevOps.
  • Projetar e implementar soluções resilientes, escaláveis e de alta disponibilidade em ambientes cloud e híbridos.
  • Definir e implementar estratégias de CI/CD, automação e Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • Estabelecer práticas de observabilidade, definir SLOs e implementar monitoramento avançado (Prometheus, Grafana LGTM, OpenTelemetry).
  • Otimizar performance, reduzir MTTR e atuar na resolução de incidentes críticos com análise de causa raiz.
  • Automatizar processos operacionais e de infraestrutura (IaC, pipelines, deploys).
  • Assegurar práticas de DevSecOps, implementando segurança desde o desenvolvimento até a produção.
  • Disseminar conhecimento técnico e promover boas práticas no time através de code reviews, RFCs e documentação técnica.
  • Gerenciar custos e otimizar recursos na nuvem.


Será bacana se você tiver:

  • Experiência sólida com práticas de SRE e alta disponibilidade.
  • Experiência avançada em Cloud (AWS, OCI ou multi-cloud) e ambientes híbridos.
  • Experiência avançada com Linux e administração de sistemas.
  • Domínio de Kubernetes, containers e orquestração (Docker, Helm, etc.).
  • Proficiência em Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible ou similares).
  • Experiência com CI/CD moderno (GitLab, ArgoCD, Jenkins ou similares).
  • Forte conhecimento em observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana LGTM, OTel, ELK).
  • Automação e scripting avançado (Python, Go ou Bash/Shell).
  • Práticas de DevSecOps e segurança em nuvem.
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas de alto impacto e arquiteturais.

title: Remote Business Analyst
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

In this role, you will be working on projects to help fine-tune large language models (like ChatGPT) using your strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! The projects will also help you learn how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples that models might get wrong, and You would articulate the correct answer & explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • English Proficiency: Ability to read and write in English with a high degree of comprehension skills.
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is preferred.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Human Resources Specialist
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

title: UGC Coordinator
description:
UGC Coordinator


About Us:

We are a DTC company who creates direct response ads. Our marketing team makes scripts for ads that sometimes needs UGC creators to film them. This is how you will fit into our company.


About the Role

We’re looking for a UGC Coordinator to own and lead our creator operations end-to-end. 

This role is critical to keeping our content engine moving: sourcing top-tier creators, managing relationships, anticipating roadblocks, negotiating UGC costs, and ensuring deliverables flow smoothly from concept to edit-ready.


You’ll be the point person between creators, Creative Strategists, and Operations , bringing structure, clarity, and momentum to a high-volume, fast-moving environment. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives on organization, takes initiative, and solves problems independently.


Key Responsibilities
  • Own the full creator lifecycle, from sourcing and vetting to delivery and payment


  • Build and maintain strong relationships with creators, ensuring clear expectations, timelines, and communication


  • Act as the operational hub for all creator-related projects, keeping internal tools (Notion, Slack, etc) accurate, up to date, and easy to understand at a glance


  • Proactively track progress across all concepts and creators, identifying risks, delays, or gaps before they escalate


  • Coordinate closely with Creative Strategists to ensure creators are fully aligned on briefs, constraints, and deliverables


  • Ensure seamless handoff of content to post-production, with well-organized assets and clear documentation


  • Handle reshoots, revisions, and edge cases with a solution-first mindset


  • Manage & negotiate creator payments and documentation in a timely and organized manner


What Success Looks Like
  • Anyone opening our tracking systems can instantly understand the status of every creator and deliverable


  • Creators feel supported, informed, and motivated to deliver high-quality content on time


  • Issues are flagged early, communicated clearly, and resolved efficiently


  • Content moves forward without bottlenecks, confusion, or last-minute fire drills


Required Qualities
  • Highly organized : able to manage multiple creators, timelines, and deliverables simultaneously


  • Proactive and accountable : you don’t wait to be asked—you move things forward


  • Problem-solver : able to find creative solutions independently before escalating


  • Strong communicator : clear, concise, and professional across Slack, email, and documentation


  • Detail-oriented but execution-focused : you balance precision with speed


Experience & Background
  • Proven experience working with creators, talent, or influencers (UGC content preferred)


  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-output environment


  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with creative, operations, and production teams



Why This Role Matters

This role is central to how our creative machine runs. As a UGC coordinator, you ensure that ideas turn into real, usable content—on time, organized, and ready to perform. Your work directly impacts creative velocity, team alignment, and overall results.



Compensation & Perks:

Base Salary from $2,000-$3,250 USD per month

Full-Time, 40 hours per week (Flexible Schedule just a few hours overlap with EST is fine)

Fully Remote

Time Zone: EST

title: Electrical BIM Lead
description:
At Eracore, we’re committed to developing talented engineers and exposing them to some of the most exciting electrical projects in the country, while becoming the most trusted partners in the industry. From coordination and prefabrication to detailed shop drawings, we support some of the most complex and high-stakes electrical projects in the United States, including Data Centers, Government Facilities, Manufacturing Plants, and cutting-edge Commercial developments.


Under strong leadership, Eracore is quickly expanding their presence in Brazil . Our goal is to develop a team of the brightest minds to take on the biggest industry challenges on some of the coolest projects in the USA.


Visit our site to see some of our projects that we want you to be a part of -->


Benefits of working with us:

  • Competitive Salary
  • Annual Bonus
  • Learning platforms that enable growth and development
  • Strong leadership and mentorship


Roles and Responsibilities

  • Oversee and lead the development, coordination, and delivery of Electrical BIM models across all project stages, ensuring compliance with project requirements, standards, and industry best practices.
  • Manage and guide the Electrical BIM team by providing technical support, quality checks, and mentorship to ensure accurate and efficient model development.
  • Collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams (Mechanical, Architectural, Structural, and other engineering teams) to ensure effective model coordination and clash-free deliverables.
  • Conduct regular model audits, data checks, and quality control reviews to ensure the integrity and reliability of electrical BIM deliverables.
  • Prepare and deliver BIM-related documentation, including model execution plans, progress reports, schedules, and technical presentations.
  • Support the integration of BIM with other digital tools such as Navisworks, Revit and clash detection software for enhanced project delivery.
  • Identify process gaps and propose improvements to enhance BIM efficiency, model accuracy, and team productivity.
  • Train and upskill team members on BIM technologies, electrical modeling techniques, and emerging industry trends.
  • Coordinate with client BIM teams to understand project expectations, provide updates, and ensure smooth communication throughout the project lifecycle.


Qualifications

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in Electrical BIM modeling, coordination, and project delivery.
  • Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Revit (Electrical discipline) with strong understanding of electrical systems
  • Strong experience using Navisworks for clash detection, coordination, and model review.
  • Familiarity with BIM 360, ACC, Bluebeam, and other industry tools.
  • Proven ability to lead, mentor, and guide juniors while maintaining high-quality output.
  • Ability to manage project timelines and client expectations.


Preferrable

  • Solid understanding of U.S. construction practices, NEC codes, and electrical engineering principle.
  • Experience in developing BIM standards, workflows, and templates for electrical systems.
  • Prior experience working on Data Centers.

title: Manager / Senior Manager, FP&A
description:
Manager / Senior Manager, FP&A



Location: Brazil (Remote)


About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. For one of our clients , a mid-sized company operating at scale, we are currently looking to hire a Manager / Senior Manager, FP&A .


About the Role


This is a hands-on FP&A role in a flat organization. While the right candidate may have a direct report in the future, this position requires a strong individual contributor who is comfortable owning analyses end to end.

We are looking for someone who is detail-oriented, highly analytical, and action-driven , with the ability to influence business decisions through financial insights.

Build and maintain 3-statement financial models , with a strong understanding of how they flow together

Develop financial models from scratch, including ROI analysis and scenario modeling

Prepare monthly and quarterly financial review decks , clearly explaining business performance using financial storytelling and waterfall analyses

Partner with leadership to identify opportunities to improve revenue, margins, and overall P&L performance

Support PE-related reporting and ad-hoc analyses

  • Help establish and improve FP&A best-practice processes in an evolving environment



Required Experience & Skills


5+ years of FP&A experience , ideally within a Fortune 500 environment

Experience in mid-sized companies is a strong plus

Strong understanding of 3-statement financial modeling

Advanced Excel skills (heavy modeling role; keyboard-driven workflows preferred)

Experience creating executive-level PowerPoint presentations with clear financial narratives

  • Experience with IBM Cognos / TM1 is a plus
  • Tableau experience is a plus, but not required
  • Private Equity experience is highly preferred



What We’re Looking For


  • Comfortable working in ambiguous, less structured environments
  • Independent and able to take ownership of projects from start to finish

Intellectually curious and proactive in asking the right questions

  • Strong bias for action , with a proven ability to challenge the status quo using data

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Remote Business Analyst
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

In this role, you will be working on projects to help fine-tune large language models (like ChatGPT) using your strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! The projects will also help you learn how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples that models might get wrong, and You would articulate the correct answer & explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • English Proficiency: Ability to read and write in English with a high degree of comprehension skills.
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is preferred.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Remote Business Analyst
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

In this role, you will be working on projects to help fine-tune large language models (like ChatGPT) using your strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! The projects will also help you learn how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples that models might get wrong, and You would articulate the correct answer & explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • English Proficiency: Ability to read and write in English with a high degree of comprehension skills.
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is preferred.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

description:

Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. title: UGC Coordinator
description:
UGC Coordinator


About Us:

We are a DTC company who creates direct response ads. Our marketing team makes scripts for ads that sometimes needs UGC creators to film them. This is how you will fit into our company.


About the Role

We’re looking for a UGC Coordinator to own and lead our creator operations end-to-end. 

This role is critical to keeping our content engine moving: sourcing top-tier creators, managing relationships, anticipating roadblocks, negotiating UGC costs, and ensuring deliverables flow smoothly from concept to edit-ready.


You’ll be the point person between creators, Creative Strategists, and Operations , bringing structure, clarity, and momentum to a high-volume, fast-moving environment. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives on organization, takes initiative, and solves problems independently.


Key Responsibilities
  • Own the full creator lifecycle, from sourcing and vetting to delivery and payment


  • Build and maintain strong relationships with creators, ensuring clear expectations, timelines, and communication


  • Act as the operational hub for all creator-related projects, keeping internal tools (Notion, Slack, etc) accurate, up to date, and easy to understand at a glance


  • Proactively track progress across all concepts and creators, identifying risks, delays, or gaps before they escalate


  • Coordinate closely with Creative Strategists to ensure creators are fully aligned on briefs, constraints, and deliverables


  • Ensure seamless handoff of content to post-production, with well-organized assets and clear documentation


  • Handle reshoots, revisions, and edge cases with a solution-first mindset


  • Manage & negotiate creator payments and documentation in a timely and organized manner


What Success Looks Like
  • Anyone opening our tracking systems can instantly understand the status of every creator and deliverable


  • Creators feel supported, informed, and motivated to deliver high-quality content on time


  • Issues are flagged early, communicated clearly, and resolved efficiently


  • Content moves forward without bottlenecks, confusion, or last-minute fire drills


Required Qualities
  • Highly organized : able to manage multiple creators, timelines, and deliverables simultaneously


  • Proactive and accountable : you don’t wait to be asked—you move things forward


  • Problem-solver : able to find creative solutions independently before escalating


  • Strong communicator : clear, concise, and professional across Slack, email, and documentation


  • Detail-oriented but execution-focused : you balance precision with speed


Experience & Background
  • Proven experience working with creators, talent, or influencers (UGC content preferred)


  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-output environment


  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with creative, operations, and production teams



Why This Role Matters

This role is central to how our creative machine runs. As a UGC coordinator, you ensure that ideas turn into real, usable content—on time, organized, and ready to perform. Your work directly impacts creative velocity, team alignment, and overall results.



Compensation & Perks:

Base Salary from $2,000-$3,250 USD per month

Full-Time, 40 hours per week (Flexible Schedule just a few hours overlap with EST is fine)

Fully Remote

Time Zone: EST

title: Electrical BIM Lead
description:
At Eracore, we’re committed to developing talented engineers and exposing them to some of the most exciting electrical projects in the country, while becoming the most trusted partners in the industry. From coordination and prefabrication to detailed shop drawings, we support some of the most complex and high-stakes electrical projects in the United States, including Data Centers, Government Facilities, Manufacturing Plants, and cutting-edge Commercial developments.


Under strong leadership, Eracore is quickly expanding their presence in Brazil . Our goal is to develop a team of the brightest minds to take on the biggest industry challenges on some of the coolest projects in the USA.


Visit our site to see some of our projects that we want you to be a part of -->


Benefits of working with us:

  • Competitive Salary
  • Annual Bonus
  • Learning platforms that enable growth and development
  • Strong leadership and mentorship


Roles and Responsibilities

  • Oversee and lead the development, coordination, and delivery of Electrical BIM models across all project stages, ensuring compliance with project requirements, standards, and industry best practices.
  • Manage and guide the Electrical BIM team by providing technical support, quality checks, and mentorship to ensure accurate and efficient model development.
  • Collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams (Mechanical, Architectural, Structural, and other engineering teams) to ensure effective model coordination and clash-free deliverables.
  • Conduct regular model audits, data checks, and quality control reviews to ensure the integrity and reliability of electrical BIM deliverables.
  • Prepare and deliver BIM-related documentation, including model execution plans, progress reports, schedules, and technical presentations.
  • Support the integration of BIM with other digital tools such as Navisworks, Revit and clash detection software for enhanced project delivery.
  • Identify process gaps and propose improvements to enhance BIM efficiency, model accuracy, and team productivity.
  • Train and upskill team members on BIM technologies, electrical modeling techniques, and emerging industry trends.
  • Coordinate with client BIM teams to understand project expectations, provide updates, and ensure smooth communication throughout the project lifecycle.


Qualifications

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in Electrical BIM modeling, coordination, and project delivery.
  • Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Revit (Electrical discipline) with strong understanding of electrical systems
  • Strong experience using Navisworks for clash detection, coordination, and model review.
  • Familiarity with BIM 360, ACC, Bluebeam, and other industry tools.
  • Proven ability to lead, mentor, and guide juniors while maintaining high-quality output.
  • Ability to manage project timelines and client expectations.


Preferrable

  • Solid understanding of U.S. construction practices, NEC codes, and electrical engineering principle.
  • Experience in developing BIM standards, workflows, and templates for electrical systems.
  • Prior experience working on Data Centers.

Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.

  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.

  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills

title: Remote Business Analyst
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

In this role, you will be working on projects to help fine-tune large language models (like ChatGPT) using your strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! The projects will also help you learn how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples that models might get wrong, and You would articulate the correct answer & explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • English Proficiency: Ability to read and write in English with a high degree of comprehension skills.
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is preferred.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: ESPECIALISTA EM DESENVOLVIMENTO DE SOFTWARE (IoT & Event Streaming) | Remoto
description:
Sobre a Localiza | Mobi7

A Mobi7 é a unidade de soluções de telemetria e IoT da Localiza, líder em mobilidade na América Latina. Nossa missão é transformar dados em inteligência para veículos conectados, com tecnologia de ponta e alta performance.


Estamos buscando um(a) Especialista em Desenvolvimento de Software para atuar no desenvolvimento de microserviços event-driven de alta performance , processando dados em tempo real de dispositivos IoT instalados em veículos. Você fará parte de um time que constrói soluções escaláveis, resilientes e observáveis, usando uma stack moderna e práticas avançadas de engenharia.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolver microserviços event-driven com Java 21+ , Spring Boot 3.5+ e Spring Cloud Stream .
  • Implementar pipelines de streaming de eventos com Apache Kafka (MSK), garantindo Exactly-Once Semantics , DLQ e particionamento eficiente.
  • Criar e evoluir contratos de dados com Avro e Schema Registry .
  • Otimizar persistência em PostgreSQL e cache distribuído com Redis .
  • Garantir observabilidade avançada com Datadog APM , logs estruturados e métricas customizadas.
  • Atuar em ambiente AWS (ECS Fargate, MSK, CloudWatch) com práticas DevOps e CI/CD.


Requisitos e qualificações

Obrigatórios:

  • Experiência sólida atuando com Java (Spring Boot).
  • Domínio avançado de Apache Kafka .
  • Experiência com AWS (ECS, Parameter Store, CloudWatch).
  • Proficiência em testes automatizados (JUnit, Testcontainers).


Desejáveis:

  • Experiência com Kotlin 2.x .
  • Conhecimento em Datadog APM , Avro , Liquibase .
  • Familiaridade com GraalVM Native Image .


Diferenciais:

  • Projetos open-source.
  • Certificação AWS.
  • Experiência com IoT/telemetria veicular.

  • Participação nos Lucros;
  • Carro Corporativo;
  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Vale Refeição;
  • Convênio Médico;

  • Acesso ilimitado a diversos cursos da nossa Universidade Localiza;
  • Programas internos de treinamento e desenvolvimento;
  • Desconto em compra e aluguel de veículos.

title: Strategic Executive Assistant to the CEO
description:
The Vision


At AI Leadership, we believe in clarity, structure, and well-run operations that allow our team to focus on the work that creates the greatest impact. The Strategic EA role exists to provide end-to-end leverage to the CEO by owning tactical and operational execution: inbox, calendar, logistics, and meeting prep. We are looking for a \"thinking partner\" who can maintain the highest standards of operational excellence and brand representation.


Who We’re Looking For


The Strategic Executive Assistant (EA) will act as the CEO's \"20% focus\" unlock, allowing him to drive 80% of business outcomes. This is not a role for someone who only follows rigid rules; we need an individual who can operate with nuance, anticipate needs before they are stated, and understand the CEO's unique decision-making framework.

You will be measured on your ability to triage the CEO's inbox to 95% without escalation and reduce calendar friction to near-zero. If you are a high-nuance individual who \"just gets it\" and thrives in a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.



Why You Should Join Us


  • AI Frontier : Gain direct exposure to the AI space and learn to build and refine AI-driven automation.
  • Career Growth : We are a growing organization that values internal mobility; this role has a path toward operations or management, as demonstrated by previous incumbents.
  • High-Impact Environment : Work alongside experienced leaders who prioritize growth, ambition, and proactive problem-solving.


Role Responsibilities


The 20% That Drives 80% of Success

  • Inbox Ownership : Manage the CEO's inbox end-to-end, responding to all messages within 24 hours using his tone and zero \"emotional leakage\".
  • Strategic Calendar Defense : Own the calendar to ensure it reflects strategic priorities; proactively identify gaps or blockers and coordinate with the family assistant to honor personal time.
  • Flawless Travel & Logistics : Execute end-to-end travel (flights, hotels, ground transport) and remain on-call for any transit issues.
  • Meeting Readiness : Maintain prep docs and ensure the CEO is fully prepared for every internal and external stakeholder interaction.

The Remaining 80%

  • HubSpot & CRM Maintenance : Review deals weekly, ensure follow-up tasks are executed on time, and load new contacts sourced by the CEO.
  • SOP & Notion Management : Fully own and update all CEO-related workflows and databases, ensuring documentation is audit-ready and searchable.
  • Small-Scope Project Management : Lead projects assigned by the Exec Ops Manager, assessing needs, developing plans, and communicating status to stakeholders.


Skills & Attributes We're Looking For


  • Methodical & Nuanced : You understand the difference between tactical execution and strategic decision-making and can operate independently in ambiguous situations.
  • 1–3 Years of Relevant Experience : Ideally supporting senior leaders or working in high-growth, corporate, or communications-heavy environments.
  • Proactive Tech-Savviness : Proficiency with Google Workspace, Slack, HubSpot (or similar CRMs), and Notion, plus a strong drive to use AI tools for speed and efficiency.
  • Executive Presence : You have a professional audio/video setup and communicate with the polish required for CEO-facing interactions.
  • Coachability : You believe feedback is the \"breakfast of champions\" and iterate quickly based on guidance.


Our Values


  • Create remarkable experiences – Every interaction is a chance to satisfy customers and internal team members.
  • Always be growing – Committed to continuous improvement and individual learning.
  • Deliver results – Taking initiative to solve problems and drive success regardless of formal responsibility.
  • Do the right thing – Prioritizing integrity, respect, and discretion in all interactions.
  • Practice what we teach – Pushing the boundaries of what it means to be AI-driven.

Compensation & Location


  • Compensation : Starts at $2,200 USD
  • Location : Remote (Working within 8 AM - 5 PM CST is preferred).


Application & Selection Process


TO APPLY:

  • Send your Resume (PDF titled \"Lastname.Firstname.EA.pdf\") to (Operations+ ).
  • Record a short demo video (2 - 4 mins max) highlighting your relevant experience for the role, skills, successes, and goals for the future. Also, we’d like you to briefly mention the following insights: Process Optimization Proposal: Share an example of how you’ve improved an operational workflow in the past (Preferably using AI or automation tools). We want you to showcase your personality, and why you believe you are the ideal candidate for the Strategic Executive Assistant role.


Our process is thorough but rewarding. Here is what you can expect:

  • Technical AI Prompt Test and Strategic Thinking Exercise
  • Behavioral Assessments : Working Genius (to assess natural strengths) and Kolbe A Index.

Three-Step Interview sequence : Initial Screening call → Head of Operations → CEO.

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer (LATAM Only)
description:
Senior Full Stack Software Engineer

Location: Remote — Brazil/US time zones (EST ±3h) • Contract: International contractor, $35/hour • Language: English (fluent) • Reports to: CTO & Engineering team.



About the role

Volatus is hiring a Senior Fullstack Engineer to own critical product work on a next‑generation platform for fertility clinics and their patients. You will join as a founding engineer, shaping both the product and the technical direction in a category where better software directly improves patient outcomes.


Tech context

You will work in a modern, greenfield stack centered on:

  • Frontend: Next.js/React , Typescript , Tailwind CSS
  • Backend: Node.js/TypeScript with a PostgreSQL core (schema design, authN,authZ, performance, transactions, triggers).
  • Data & integrations: Third-party API integrations ; performance profiling (e.g., Lighthouse).
  • Quality: Unit, integration, and end-to-end tests; CI/CD .
  • Collaboration: Work closely with our Head of Engineering, Principal Engineer, Product Designer, and CEO.


What you will do

  • Build and ship end‑to‑end features across the Next.js frontend and Node/TypeScript backend. 
  • Model and tune Postgres schemas; ensure secure authN/authZ and strong performance. 
  • Integrate external APIs and improve app reliability and speed (including Lighthouse‑driven improvements). 
  • Write reliable tests (unit/integration/e2e) and contribute to CI/CD workflows. 
  • Make pragmatic early‑stage architectural decisions and raise the engineering bar.


What you will bring

  • Proficiency with AI tools to accelerate development and quality. 
  • Strong production experience with Next.js/React, Node.js, and TypeScript.
  • Tailwind & CSS mastery; responsive, accessible UI. 
  • PostgreSQL expertise (modeling, security/auth, performance, transactions, triggers). 
  • Integrations experience (third‑party APIs) and solid testing practice (unit/integration/e2e). 
  • Portfolio or links to shipped projects/code.


90-day outcomes

In your first 90 days, you will:

  • Lead at least one significant feature from design to production, used by real clinics or internal teams.​
  • Improve a key part of the frontend experience (e.g., performance, usability, or design consistency) and document the standards for others.​
  • Own part of the backend or data model, including at least one meaningful performance or reliability improvement.​
  • Help define or refine testing and deployment practices so the team can ship faster and with more confidence.


Nice to have

  • Experience building voice‑controlled components / speech‑to‑text. 
  • Experience interacting with AI models from the web app.


How we work

  • Remote within EST ±3 hours preferred ; open to other time zones if you can collaborate on US‑friendly hours.
  • Small, senior team with a strong bias toward action and ownership ;
  • Product-led culture : engineers are closely involved in discovery, tradeoff discussions, and shaping the roadmap.


Hiring process

  • Coderpad Challenge (60 min)
  • Intro chat (45 min) – mutual fit and role context.
  • Technical deep‑dive & Live testing – discuss systems you’ve built; pair on a focused problem (no whiteboard trivia).
  • Team conversation – meet engineering + product leadership.
  • References & offer.


Volatus is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.

title: Customer Success Specialist, Life Sciences
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


As a Customer Success Specialist, you will help professors at leading universities in the US integrate JoVE videos into their courses to improve teaching outcomes and student success. You'll play a key role in ensuring users get the most value from their JoVE subscription.



Responsibilities:


  • Conduct daily outreach to Faculty (via calls, emails, and 1:1 demos) to set up JoVE integrations in courses and increase product usage.
  • Increase JoVE adoption by delivering product awareness sessions across existing customer universities and research institutes.
  • Grow engagement and usage by delivering presentations at (1) exhibits and conferences, (2) university seminars and workshops, and (3) onsite customer visits.
  • Strengthen subscription renewal outcomes by ensuring smooth implementation support, and consistent usage of JoVE resources.
  • Influence product decisions by communicating customer feedback to sales, product, and marketing teams.


Requirements:


  • A Master's degree or PhD in Life Science disciplines.
  • 1-3 years of experience in customer facing roles is preferred.
  • Fluent communication skills English.
  • Knowledge of education, market trends, and challenges in assigned content areas i.e. Biology, Chemistry, Medicine, Physics, Engineering, or Psychology.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a passion for remote relationship-building.
  • Experience in networking using cold calling is preferred.


Please share your resume in English.


Why Join JoVE?


  • You can expect compensation packages competitively placed within the local market.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

description:
About You

You are a hands-on senior engineer who enjoys owning complex systems end-to-end. You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Solid experience designing and operating REST and/or GraphQL APIs .
  • Hands-on experience with AWS serverless services such as Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, S3, CloudFront, and Cognito.

You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Collaborate closely with product, backend, and frontend teams to deliver cohesive full-stack solutions.
  • Participate in architectural discussions, perform code reviews, and promote best engineering practices.


Qualifications

  • Strong experience building full-stack apps with React, Node.js and TypeScript .
  • Hands-on experience with AWS serverless : Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS, DynamoDB.
  • Experience building REST / GraphQL APIs .

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Founding Application Engineer (Agentic AI)
description:
ABOUT VOX

VOX is an Agentic Market Research platform that is Introducing a new model in Market Research. We’re turning Buyer-Sourced Insights into Real-Time Revenue, directly tackling the critical need for precise, timely, and relevant buyer data.


Our solution moves beyond traditional methods by utilizing human-led research powered by AI to provide real-time, human-validated insights.


ABOUT THE ROLE

You will own and scale VOX’s engineering organization as we enter our next phase of growth. As a founding engineer, you’ll define the technical vision, architect the core product, and partner closely with leadership to build an AI-native platform—leveraging agentic AI systems to scale subject-matter expertise.


This role is ideal for someone excited to build from zero to one, operate with high ownership, and shape both the product and the engineering culture from the ground up.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Architect and Build

  • Design and implement VOX’s initial product architecture and tech stack from scratch.
  • Build and iterate on MVPs with a strong bias toward speed, learning, and scalability.
  • Architect AI-first systems, including agent-based workflows that reason, plan, and act autonomously.


Agentic AI Development

  • Design, build, and deploy agentic AI systems (e.g., LLM-powered agents, tool-using agents, multi-agent workflows).
  • Integrate AI agents with product features such as expert reasoning, decision support, orchestration, and automation.
  • Evaluate and optimize models, prompts, tools, and feedback loops for reliability, performance, and cost.


Full-Stack Development

  • Work across the full stack—frontend, backend, data, and infrastructure.
  • Build APIs, services, and data pipelines that support AI-driven workflows and real-time interactions.


Product & Technical Strategy

  • Collaborate closely with founders and early customers to define product requirements and roadmap.
  • Translate ambiguous problems into shipped features, iterating rapidly based on real-world feedback.
  • Make pragmatic trade-offs between speed, quality, and scalability in an early-stage environment.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Technical Expertise

  • Strong software engineering background with proficiency in languages such as Python and JavaScript.
  • Experience with databases (SQL/NoSQL), APIs, and cloud platforms (AWS or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with modern AI/ML tooling (e.g., LLM APIs, vector databases, orchestration frameworks).


Agentic AI & Systems Thinking

  • Hands-on experience building or experimenting with agentic AI systems, autonomous workflows, or LLM-powered applications.
  • Strong understanding of system design, reliability, and failure modes in AI-driven products.
  • Ability to reason about trade-offs in model selection, latency, cost, and accuracy.


Problem-Solving & Product Mindset

  • Exceptional problem-solving skills and comfort operating in ambiguity.
  • Strong product intuition with a deep focus on user experience and business impact.


Communication & Ownership

  • Excellent communication skills, able to bridge technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • High degree of ownership, autonomy, and adaptability in a fast-moving startup environment.



* Competitive base salary plus meaningful equity.

description:

Our mission is to make health and wellness services accessible and engaging for everyone. The Sofia Unfiltered podcast is our platform to highlight the journeys, insights, and expertise of health and wellness professionals, amplifying their stories to inspire and educate a broader audience.
