title: Product Owner (PO)
description:
Quer crescer junto com uma empresa que está transformando a educação com tecnologia e Inteligência Artificial?


Se você gosta de organizar complexidade, trabalhar próximo de times técnicos e transformar necessidades de negócio em produtos digitais de alto impacto, essa vaga pode ser para você!


Estamos em busca de um(a) Product Owner (PO) para atuar na nossa nova frente de produtos e soluções baseadas em IA, ajudando a maximizar o valor de agentes inteligentes, integrações e automações desenvolvidas pela Trivium.


Como será a sua contribuição no time:


  • Gerenciar e priorizar o backlog do produto, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos da empresa.
  • Conduzir atividades de discovery, incluindo: benchmark de mercado, conversas com clientes, interação com times internos e stakeholders
  • Traduzir necessidades de negócio e de usuários em histórias bem definidas, com critérios de aceitação claros.
  • Apoiar a definição e comunicação da visão do produto, garantindo clareza e alinhamento entre tecnologia, dados, design e negócio.
  • Acompanhar o desenvolvimento das soluções, validando entregas, hipóteses e resultados.
  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias ágeis (planning, daily, review, retrospectiva e refinamentos).
  • Monitorar métricas de performance e adoção (KPIs, uso, qualidade, feedback), propondo melhorias contínuas.
  • Atuar como ponto central de alinhamento entre stakeholders, usuários e time técnico.


Se você já atuou como Product Owner (ou em papel equivalente), gosta de trabalhar com produtos digitais e quer fazer parte da construção de soluções com IA e automação, em um ambiente colaborativo e em crescimento — essa oportunidade pode ser sua!


Requisitos mínimos:


  • Experiência prévia como Product Owner ou atuação equivalente em times de produto.
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum e/ou Kanban).
  • Experiência na gestão e priorização de backlog.
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos claros e acionáveis para times técnicos.
  • Perfil analítico, com facilidade para aprofundar problemas, identificar oportunidades e apoiar decisões.
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal, especialmente para documentação e alinhamento entre áreas.
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões orientadas a dados, equilibrando valor de negócio e experiência do usuário.


Diferenciais que contam pontos:


  • Vivência com produtos ou funcionalidades baseadas em IA, automação ou dados.
  • Experiência em startups ou empresas de tecnologia.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão de produto (ClickUp, Jira, Linear, Notion, etc.).
  • Noções de desenvolvimento de software, UI/UX ou trabalho próximo a times técnicos.
  • Interesse em acompanhar métricas como adoção, performance, qualidade e impacto do produto.


O que você vai encontrar aqui:


  • Um ambiente colaborativo, com autonomia e aprendizado contínuo.
  • Atuação direta em produtos e soluções com Inteligência Artificial aplicada.
  • Proximidade com times técnicos e decisões estratégicas.
  • Espaço para contribuir ativamente na construção de uma nova área da empresa.
  • Oportunidade real de crescimento profissional.

title: Sr. Product Analyst
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our flag ship product is a Chromium browser, that provides a powerful and secure way to search the web; and our growing ecosystem includes a portfolio of innovative mobile products. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Product Analyst to join our team and help drive data-informed decisions to help grow and optimize our browser products. This individual will play a critical role in analyzing user behavior, evaluating feature performance, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high quality data insights. This role is best suited for a confident self-starter and requires a blend of creative vision, technical know-how, strong communication / presentation skills, and exceptional organizational skills.


Key Responsibilities


Data Analysis, Insights, & Skills

  • Extract, clean, and analyze data using SQL to understand product performance, user behavior, and business trends
  • Proficient at using / analyzing excel, dashboards, reports, and KPIs to monitor product health/performance
  • Understands what constitutes “accuracy” for various data sets and can run checks to verify the accuracy of a data set
  • Automatically goes the “extra step” on assigned tasks.
  • Able to provide actionable recommendations to product managers and leadership teams
  • Capable of providing clear and concise write-ups for complex analysis
  • Capable of performing tasks with speed and efficiency


Personality Traits

  • People excel in this position that are self – starters, confident, and competitive
  • They are capable of self-management and independent decision making
  • They have strong time/priority management skills
  • They are team players and can see problems from multiple points of view.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Communication

  • Work closely with Product Managers, Engineering, QA’s, User Acquisition, and Design teams to translate business requirements into analytical solutions
  • Partner with stakeholders to identify key metrics and measure the success of product initiatives
  • Understands the differences between team level updates and executive level updates


Experimentation & Optimization

  • Support A/B testing and experimentation frameworks to validate hypotheses and inform product decisions
  • Analyze experiment results and recommend next steps for product improvements


Agile/Scrum Processes

  • Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and daily stand-ups to align analytics work with product development priorities
  • Deliver insights in iterative cycles that align with Agile methodologies


Who You Are


  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or similar)
  • 5+ years of firsthand experience in management/analysis of data within a Structured Query Language (SQL) database (Preferred: Microsoft SQL Server, Amazon Redshift) with proven SQL and query writing skills
  • Experience collecting and analyzing data and reporting on the results using Excel or a statistical software package
  • Demonstrated ability to extract and assimilate data from multiple sources and communicate analysis in a concise, easy-to-understand, and actionable format
  • Strong proficiency in SQL for data manipulation and analysis

title: Remote Business Analyst (Portuguese) - 54880
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and Portuguese)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

  • Manter-se atualizado sobre tendências e inovações tecnológicas, promovendo a melhoria contínua.
  • Executar outras atividades correlatas, conforme orientação da liderança.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Proficiência no uso do framework NestJS, incluindo conceitos como injeção de dependência, interceptors, pipes, guards e modules.
  • Experiência na criação e manutenção de APIs REST, seguindo boas práticas de versionamento, documentação e segurança.

description:

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
Description :

We are hiring a full-time Salesforce Developer to support a fast-moving merchant cash advance company. This role is focused on fixing, optimizing, and improving the Salesforce environment the sales team uses every day. You will handle UI updates, system configuration, integrations, and fast-turnaround fixes that directly impact how quickly deals move through the pipeline. Full-time. Fully remote. Must be ENGLISH-SPEAKING.


Hours: 9am–5pm EST.

Salary: $4,000/mo


Key Responsibilities:

• Own Salesforce configuration: fields, formulas, layouts, list views, role hierarchy, and sharing settings

• Set up and maintain integrations — especially telephony tools like RingCentral inside Salesforce

• Improve UI and usability for reps, ensuring workflows are clear and easy to follow

• Build small Lightning components or UI enhancements when needed

• Troubleshoot and fix Lightning integration issues, permission problems, and visibility restrictions

• Adjust and maintain workflow automation (Flow, processes, rules) to support the sales process

• Update dashboards, create filtered list views, and improve record access structure

• Build and refine CRM actions such as the “Next Opportunity” button and other quick actions

• Handle fast-turnaround tasks when urgent fixes are needed (same-day or <30 minutes when possible)

• Clean up confusing configurations, inconsistent UI, or broken logic

• Document changes and communicate clearly with leadership about what was done and why


Key Qualifications:

• 3+ years of Salesforce Admin or Developer experience

• Strong understanding of Salesforce Sales Cloud

• Experience with Lightning UI (components, layouts, actions, navigation)

• Ability to diagnose and fix permission issues, sharing rules, and record visibility

• Comfortable maintaining and improving telephony integrations (RingCentral preferred)

• Strong grasp of Salesforce automation: Flows, process automations, workflow rules

• Able to move quickly, prioritize urgent fixes, and troubleshoot without hand-holding

• Detail-oriented with clean documentation and high accuracy

• Must own and be able to use a working computer with high-speed internet

• Must be ENGLISH-SPEAKING


Nice to Have:

• Experience working with merchant cash advance companies

• Background in CRM architecture or workflow optimization

• Ability to advise on long-term Salesforce structure, not just fix short-term issues

title: Customer Success Specialist, Life Sciences
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


As a Customer Success Specialist, you will help professors at leading universities in the US integrate JoVE videos into their courses to improve teaching outcomes and student success. You'll play a key role in ensuring users get the most value from their JoVE subscription.



Responsibilities:


  • Conduct daily outreach to Faculty (via calls, emails, and 1:1 demos) to set up JoVE integrations in courses and increase product usage.
  • Increase JoVE adoption by delivering product awareness sessions across existing customer universities and research institutes.
  • Grow engagement and usage by delivering presentations at (1) exhibits and conferences, (2) university seminars and workshops, and (3) onsite customer visits.
  • Strengthen subscription renewal outcomes by ensuring smooth implementation support, and consistent usage of JoVE resources.
  • Influence product decisions by communicating customer feedback to sales, product, and marketing teams.


Requirements:


  • A Master's degree or PhD in Life Science disciplines.
  • 1-3 years of experience in customer facing roles is preferred.
  • Fluent communication skills English.
  • Knowledge of education, market trends, and challenges in assigned content areas i.e. Biology, Chemistry, Medicine, Physics, Engineering, or Psychology.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a passion for remote relationship-building.
  • Experience in networking using cold calling is preferred.


Please share your resume in English.


Why Join JoVE?


  • You can expect compensation packages competitively placed within the local market.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Analista de Cultura e Engajamento
description:
Analista de Cultura e Engajamento


Sobre a vaga

A Dropservice é a base por trás do crescimento de um ecossistema de marcas com propósito. Conectamos pessoas, processos e estratégia para oferecer suporte para que nossas marcas cresçam com clareza, eficiência e impacto.

title: Sr. Product Analyst
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our flag ship product is a Chromium browser, that provides a powerful and secure way to search the web; and our growing ecosystem includes a portfolio of innovative mobile products. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Product Analyst to join our team and help drive data-informed decisions to help grow and optimize our browser products. This individual will play a critical role in analyzing user behavior, evaluating feature performance, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high quality data insights. This role is best suited for a confident self-starter and requires a blend of creative vision, technical know-how, strong communication / presentation skills, and exceptional organizational skills.


Key Responsibilities


Data Analysis, Insights, & Skills

  • Extract, clean, and analyze data using SQL to understand product performance, user behavior, and business trends
  • Proficient at using / analyzing excel, dashboards, reports, and KPIs to monitor product health/performance
  • Understands what constitutes “accuracy” for various data sets and can run checks to verify the accuracy of a data set
  • Automatically goes the “extra step” on assigned tasks.
  • Able to provide actionable recommendations to product managers and leadership teams
  • Capable of providing clear and concise write-ups for complex analysis
  • Capable of performing tasks with speed and efficiency


Personality Traits

  • People excel in this position that are self – starters, confident, and competitive
  • They are capable of self-management and independent decision making
  • They have strong time/priority management skills
  • They are team players and can see problems from multiple points of view.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Communication

  • Work closely with Product Managers, Engineering, QA’s, User Acquisition, and Design teams to translate business requirements into analytical solutions
  • Partner with stakeholders to identify key metrics and measure the success of product initiatives
  • Understands the differences between team level updates and executive level updates


Experimentation & Optimization

  • Support A/B testing and experimentation frameworks to validate hypotheses and inform product decisions
  • Analyze experiment results and recommend next steps for product improvements


Agile/Scrum Processes

  • Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and daily stand-ups to align analytics work with product development priorities
  • Deliver insights in iterative cycles that align with Agile methodologies


Who You Are


  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or similar)
  • 5+ years of firsthand experience in management/analysis of data within a Structured Query Language (SQL) database (Preferred: Microsoft SQL Server, Amazon Redshift) with proven SQL and query writing skills
  • Experience collecting and analyzing data and reporting on the results using Excel or a statistical software package
  • Demonstrated ability to extract and assimilate data from multiple sources and communicate analysis in a concise, easy-to-understand, and actionable format
  • Strong proficiency in SQL for data manipulation and analysis
  • Solid understanding of Agile/Scrum frameworks and working in iterative development cycles
  • Ability to communicate complex findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences

title: ESPECIALISTA EM DESENVOLVIMENTO DE SOFTWARE (IoT & Event Streaming) | Remoto
description:
Sobre a Localiza | Mobi7

A Mobi7 é a unidade de soluções de telemetria e IoT da Localiza, líder em mobilidade na América Latina. Nossa missão é transformar dados em inteligência para veículos conectados, com tecnologia de ponta e alta performance.


Estamos buscando um(a) Especialista em Desenvolvimento de Software para atuar no desenvolvimento de microserviços event-driven de alta performance , processando dados em tempo real de dispositivos IoT instalados em veículos. Você fará parte de um time que constrói soluções escaláveis, resilientes e observáveis, usando uma stack moderna e práticas avançadas de engenharia.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolver microserviços event-driven com Java 21+ , Spring Boot 3.5+ e Spring Cloud Stream .
  • Implementar pipelines de streaming de eventos com Apache Kafka (MSK), garantindo Exactly-Once Semantics , DLQ e particionamento eficiente.
  • Criar e evoluir contratos de dados com Avro e Schema Registry .
  • Otimizar persistência em PostgreSQL e cache distribuído com Redis .
  • Garantir observabilidade avançada com Datadog APM , logs estruturados e métricas customizadas.
  • Atuar em ambiente AWS (ECS Fargate, MSK, CloudWatch) com práticas DevOps e CI/CD.


Requisitos e qualificações

Obrigatórios:

  • Experiência sólida atuando com Java (Spring Boot).
  • Domínio avançado de Apache Kafka .
  • Experiência com AWS (ECS, Parameter Store, CloudWatch).
  • Proficiência em testes automatizados (JUnit, Testcontainers).

title: Senior Product Experience Designer (Remote) - B2B Healthtech SaaS
description:
• Ongoing contract role · 10 hours per week · Remote (Brazil Based)
  • Flexible hours · PST time zone overlap preferred
  • International team across Brazil and North America
  • 5+ years of designing SaaS web applications (required)
  • Hands-on product experience design - workflows, flows, wireframes
  • Fluent English required - written and spoken


About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Experience Designer to help shape the user experience of a SaaS web application platform that supports healthcare practitioners in delivering better patient outcomes.


This role is intentionally scoped at 10 hours per week , with some overlap during PST business hours required. It’s focused on senior-level product experience design - the kind of work where judgment, clarity, and good decisions matter.


This role is well suited to someone who:

  • enjoys focused, high-impact work,
  • may already have other professional commitments,
  • and values collaborating with a small, international team on meaningful product problems.


You’ll work closely with the founder and an experienced product, design, and development team to design end-to-end product experiences — from early concepts through to wireframes ready for visual design and implementation.


This is not a UI-polish role, and it’s not advisory. You will be designing the product experience itself.


About Optive

We build software that helps functional medicine and healthcare practitioners deliver better patient outcomes through clearer data, better insight, and more consistent follow-up care. Optive is the next stage of this work - a patient engagement and care platform designed to support ongoing, relationship-based healthcare rather than one-off interactions.


Our team works across two closely related platforms:

  • Optive - a patient engagement and care platform
  • Optimal DX - an established diagnostics and lab interpretation system used by practitioners today


You’ll contribute experience design work across both platforms , helping ensure coherence and clarity as the ecosystem evolves.


Our team is fully remote and international, working across Brazil and North America, with collaboration primarily across PST time zones - often a good fit for Brazil-based team members who prefer some evening overlap.



What You'll Do

  • Design end-to-end user journeys for complex SaaS web applications
  • Translate product goals into clear workflows, flows, and wireframes
  • Think through user intent, edge cases, and complexity vs. simplicity trade-offs
  • Create low-fidelity wireframes and experience diagrams (Figma, Miro, etc.)
  • Collaborate with a senior visual designer who will take your work into high-fidelity design
  • Challenge assumptions constructively and improve product clarity early - before development begins
  • Communicate clearly with an international team in English , both written and spoken


Why this Role Might be a Fit

  • Have 5+ years of experience designing customer-facing SaaS products or complex web applications
  • Have worked on products that real customers use in production
  • Are comfortable designing multi-step workflows and role-based experiences
  • Understand how UX decisions impact usability, adoption, and real-world outcomes
  • Prefer focused, senior-level contribution over full-time availability
  • Are comfortable working independently with a high level of trust
  • Can overlap some working hours with PST
  • Communicate fluently in English


Preferred Background

While we care far more about what you’ve designed and shipped than your exact job title, this role is best suited to someone who has:

  • Designed complex SaaS or web applications used in production
  • Owned or heavily influenced end-to-end product experiences , not just individual screens
  • Worked closely with founders, product leaders, or engineering teams in small to mid-sized software companies
  • Designed workflows where clarity, trust, and correctness matter (e.g. healthcare, fintech, B2B, or data-heavy products)
  • Been accountable for experience decisions that had real user and business impact


If your experience is primarily marketing sites, brand work, or UI-only execution, this role is unlikely to be a fit.


Proof Matters

We strongly prefer candidates who can show real work, such as:

  • Screenshots of shipped SaaS products
  • Annotated flows or wireframes
  • Case studies explaining experience design decisions
  • Clear examples of problems you personally solved


We understand NDAs exist — but we’re looking for people who can point to real experience design work and talk concretely about the decisions behind it.


How to Apply

Apply via LinkedIn.


Please include:

  • A short note about your experience designing SaaS or web applications
  • Links to relevant work (portfolio, screenshots, case studies)
  • Anything that clearly shows how you shaped the product experience


Applications without clear experience in SaaS or web-based product design will not be considered.

title: Podcast Assistant
description:
About Sofia Health: Sofia Health is a fast-growing marketplace dedicated to connecting clients with wellness providers across various disciplines. Our mission is to make health and wellness services accessible and engaging for everyone. The Sofia Unfiltered podcast is our platform to highlight the journeys, insights, and expertise of health and wellness professionals, amplifying their stories to inspire and educate a broader audience.


Role Overview: We're looking for a creative and organized Podcast Production Assistant to support our production team with various aspects of podcast creation. This role will be instrumental in the entire production process, from pre-production through post-production, and will also require expertise in email writing to promote episodes, coordinate with guests, and keep our audience engaged. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone passionate about storytelling, health and wellness, and digital media.


Responsibilities:

  • Assist with the day-to-day production of the Sofia Unfiltered podcast, including scheduling, script assistance, and audio/video editing support
  • Coordinate guest outreach, scheduling, and follow-ups to ensure a smooth guest experience
  • Draft show notes, guest bios, and key talking points for the host
  • Upload episodes, titles, descriptions, and assets to Spotify, YouTube, Apple Podcasts, and hosting platforms
  • Track episode releases, metrics, and guest promotion deliverables
  • Maintain podcast calendar and content pipeline
  • Research new guests that align with our mission and audience
  • Organize clips for promotion or pass timestamps to our editor
  • Ensure guest intake forms and promotional materials are received
  • Coordinating with internal teams to share content and updates
  • Assist with research, including background on guests and trending wellness topics
  • Support social media promotion of podcast episodes
  • Manage episode timelines, deadlines, and organization within our content calendar


Qualifications:

  • Strong writing skills, with experience in email marketing or professional email communications
  • Background in media, communications, journalism, or related field preferred
  • Experience with podcast production, audio editing software (e.g., Adobe Audition, Audacity), or video editing tools is a plus
  • Knowledge of health and wellness topics and trends is a bonus
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to work independently and meet deadlines in a remote environment
  • Enthusiasm for storytelling and podcasting, with a creative mindset

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Sênior
description:
Como Senior Backend Developer na área de DTI da Sankhya, você terá a missão de atuar como uma ponte estratégica entre desenvolvimento e operações, com forte contribuição técnica em engenharia de software Java , automação e práticas modernas de entrega contínua.

Você será peça-chave na evolução arquitetural dos nossos serviços, garantindo qualidade, estabilidade e eficiência nas entregas, colaborando de forma próxima com times de desenvolvimento, segurança e operações.


Se você é um desenvolvedor experiente com mindset DevOps, apaixonado por automação, escalabilidade e software bem projetado, essa vaga é para você.



RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções e serviços internos em Java , promovendo boas práticas de engenharia, padrões de projeto e qualidade de código;
  • Contribuir na evolução da plataforma de CI/CD, apoiando os times de desenvolvimento na construção de pipelines eficientes, estáveis e seguros;
  • Automatizar processos e fluxos de entrega, aplicando práticas de integração contínua, testes automatizados e deploy contínuo, com foco em simplificação e padronização;
  • Apoiar a criação e manutenção de infraestrutura como código (ex.: Terraform, OpenTofu), garantindo governança, rastreabilidade e consistência de ambientes;
  • Identificar e solucionar problemas complexos de performance e disponibilidade, tanto no código Java quanto no ecossistema que o cerca;
  • Acompanhar e orientar equipes de desenvolvimento no uso de ferramentas, processos e práticas DevOps, fortalecendo a cultura de colaboração e melhoria contínua.



REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento Java (Java 8+), boas práticas, testes, APIs REST, padrões de projeto e performance;
  • Experiência prática com pipelines de CI/CD (GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions ou equivalentes);
  • Conhecimento de infraestrutura como código (Terraform, CloudFormation ou similares);
  • Vivência com containers e orquestração (Docker e Kubernetes);
  • Domínio de Linux e fundamentos de redes e segurança;
  • Experiência com pelo menos um provedor de cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure);
  • Vivência com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog etc.);
  • Capacidade de diagnosticar problemas complexos em ambientes distribuídos.


Desejáveis

  • Conhecimento em linguagens de automação/scripting (Shell, Python etc.);
  • Experiência com arquitetura orientada a microsserviços;
  • Práticas de engenharia como testes automatizados, integração contínua e revisão de código;
  • Noções de otimização de custo/performance em cloud;
  • Experiência com estratégias de deployment (blue/green, canary, rollback automatizado).



Se você busca um desafio para liderar a evolução tecnológica de um dos maiores ERPs do país, com impacto direto na experiência de milhares de usuários, queremos te conhecer!

title: Senior Software Engineer UX (C# / XAML)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Software Engineer, UX, with 5+ years of professional experience to join our U.S. client. Candidates must have a strong background in C#, XAML, WinForms, and MAUI.

The ideal candidate will collaborate with a small team in an agile environment to improve our clients' UI experiences by developing new functionality and maintaining existing client applications. You must have experience with UI design, development, and debugging.

Protecting over 17,000 facilities in 80 countries across six continents, our client is a global leader in providing comprehensive visibility into critical infrastructure management, enabling swift problem resolution, waste reduction, and cost efficiencies while significantly elevating operational performance. The company's suite of software solutions enables customers to quickly identify and remediate critical plant issues, elevate plant operational performance, and ultimately drive safer, more efficient, always-on operations.


Responsibilities

  • Seek input from stakeholders, share and review UI mockups, synthesize feedback on usability, carefully consider localization, and empower other team members to create learning materials for the new UI
  • Develop view models, views, custom controls, and UI patterns in C# and XAML in both MAUI and WPF
  • Transform existing WinForms dialogs into reimagined and improved WPF implementations
  • Take ownership of solving interesting problems, architect new objects, improve the solutions of other team members, and maintain the solution as it is deployed globally


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments using C# and XAML
  • Strong proficiency in WinForms and MAUI
  • Ability to contribute across the stack from back-end logic and data modeling to key front-end integrations
  • Strong understanding of component-based architecture, state management, responsive design, and performance optimization
  • Experience working collaboratively with design and back-end teams
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams


Preferred Experience

  • Experience with third-party controls, such as Telerik and ComponentOne
  • Experience with web development, such as Angular and ASP.NET
  • Familiar with Microsoft SQL Server and Entity Framework

Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:

Cientista de Dados / Analista de Data Science (Modelagem Preditiva)


Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional de Data Science para atuar no desenvolvimento de modelos estatísticos e soluções de análise preditiva, contribuindo diretamente para projetos de alto impacto no negócio, em ambientes complexos e desafiadores.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e implementar modelos estatísticos e preditivos customizados;
  • Atuar em desafios de análise preditiva aplicada ao negócio, especialmente no contexto de crédito;
  • Realizar manipulação, tratamento e análise exploratória de dados;
  • Garantir qualidade, consistência e acurácia dos modelos desenvolvidos;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com times multidisciplinares de Analytics e Data Science;
  • Traduzir análises complexas em insights claros por meio de Data Storytelling, apoiando a tomada de decisão de stakeholders;

title: Desenvolvedor web sênior
description:
Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Sênior para atuar no desenvolvimento de sistemas distribuídos e escaláveis, utilizando tecnologias modernas para garantir alta performance, segurança e confiabilidade. O profissional será peça-chave na construção de soluções inovadoras, com foco em sistemas de pagamento e transações financeiras.


A Movingpay trabalha na área de meios de pagamento e ofertamos soluções para gerenciamento de transações, liquidações, conciliações e registros de transações.


Regime de contratação:

  • CLT


Responsabilidades:

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter sistemas distribuídos e escaláveis com alto desempenho e resiliência.
  • Criar e otimizar soluções de backend em Node.js e JavaScript, integrando serviços distribuídos.
  • Desenvolver interfaces responsivas e eficientes utilizando React.
  • Implementar e gerenciar bancos de dados relacionais (MySQL) e não relacionais (MongoDB) para garantir a consistência e escalabilidade dos sistemas.
  • Trabalhar com AWS (ou outros provedores cloud) para criar arquiteturas robustas e escaláveis.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de produto e design para traduzir requisitos de negócios em soluções técnicas.
  • Garantir a qualidade do código através de boas práticas, testes automatizados e revisões.
  • Diagnosticar e solucionar problemas em ambientes de produção complexos.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida no desenvolvimento de sistemas utilizando Node.js, JavaScript e React.
  • Conhecimento avançado em arquiteturas distribuídas, escaláveis e baseadas em microsserviços.
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (MySQL) e não relacionais (MongoDB).
  • Vivência em ambientes de computação em nuvem, preferencialmente AWS (Lambda, S3, API Gateway, DynamoDB, etc.).
  • Familiaridade com boas práticas de desenvolvimento, como design patterns, testes unitários e CI/CD.
  • Conhecimento em estratégias de caching, mensageria e filas (Redis, Kafka, ou similares).
  • Habilidade para otimizar e escalar sistemas de alta demanda.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prévia com gateways de pagamento, conciliação financeira ou plataformas de transações, subadquirentes, adquirentes.
  • Conhecimento sobre meios de pagamento como crédito, débito e Pix.
  • Experiência em integrações com adquirentes e instituições financeiras.
  • Familiaridade com segurança de transações financeiras (ex.: PCI-DSS, criptografia, autenticação, etc.).
  • Experiência em ambientes ágeis com foco em entrega contínua.

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
Description :

We are hiring a full-time Salesforce Developer to support a fast-moving merchant cash advance company. This role is focused on fixing, optimizing, and improving the Salesforce environment the sales team uses every day. You will handle UI updates, system configuration, integrations, and fast-turnaround fixes that directly impact how quickly deals move through the pipeline. Full-time. Fully remote. Must be ENGLISH-SPEAKING.


Hours: 9am–5pm EST.

Salary: $4,000/mo


Key Responsibilities:

• Own Salesforce configuration: fields, formulas, layouts, list views, role hierarchy, and sharing settings

• Set up and maintain integrations — especially telephony tools like RingCentral inside Salesforce

• Improve UI and usability for reps, ensuring workflows are clear and easy to follow

• Build small Lightning components or UI enhancements when needed

• Troubleshoot and fix Lightning integration issues, permission problems, and visibility restrictions

• Adjust and maintain workflow automation (Flow, processes, rules) to support the sales process

• Update dashboards, create filtered list views, and improve record access structure

• Build and refine CRM actions such as the “Next Opportunity” button and other quick actions

• Handle fast-turnaround tasks when urgent fixes are needed (same-day or <30 minutes when possible)

• Clean up confusing configurations, inconsistent UI, or broken logic

• Document changes and communicate clearly with leadership about what was done and why


Key Qualifications:

• 3+ years of Salesforce Admin or Developer experience

• Strong understanding of Salesforce Sales Cloud

• Experience with Lightning UI (components, layouts, actions, navigation)

• Ability to diagnose and fix permission issues, sharing rules, and record visibility

• Comfortable maintaining and improving telephony integrations (RingCentral preferred)

• Strong grasp of Salesforce automation: Flows, process automations, workflow rules

• Able to move quickly, prioritize urgent fixes, and troubleshoot without hand-holding

• Detail-oriented with clean documentation and high accuracy

• Must own and be able to use a working computer with high-speed internet

• Must be ENGLISH-SPEAKING


Nice to Have:

• Experience working with merchant cash advance companies

• Background in CRM architecture or workflow optimization

• Ability to advise on long-term Salesforce structure, not just fix short-term issues

title: Search Engine Optimization Specialist (No Quick Applies) — Remote, Full-Time
description:
Hey, I’m Dustin, CEO of BestLyfe Group.


We’re on a mission to help small businesses punch above their weight in the digital world. Most agencies still treat SEO like it’s 2010—manual, slow, and keyword-stuffed. Not us.


At BLG, we harness AI and AI-driven platforms to make SEO sharper, faster, and more effective than old-school methods ever could. From automating deep audits to building smarter keyword strategies to scaling content optimization—AI isn’t here to replace you, it’s here to make you unstoppable.


And here’s the kicker: you won’t be going it alone. We’ve got routine access to one of the best SEO mentors in the world and his team—so you’ll be learning and executing at a level most SEOs only dream about.


If you’re the kind of SEO who geeks out over ranking wins, but also gets fired up about how technology can multiply impact, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.


Position: SEO Specialist

  • Location: Remote
  • Status: Full-Time
  • Start Date: When you’re ready to help businesses dominate Google


Here’s what we need you to do:

  • Run technical SEO audits with precision (site speed, schema, indexing, Core Web Vitals).
  • Execute on-page optimization: keyword research, metadata, content structure, internal linking.
  • Design and implement content-driven campaigns that attract and convert.
  • Leverage AI-driven platforms to optimize smarter, automate grunt work, and surface insights faster.
  • Collaborate with devs and designers so our sites are SEO-ready from launch.
  • Track, analyze, and report KPIs—tying rankings and traffic back to real revenue impact.


Bonus points if you:

  • Already live inside tools like Search Atlas, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, or Surfer SEO.
  • Understand how conversion optimization and SEO fuel each other.
  • Obsess over Core Web Vitals and site speed like they’re a leaderboard.
  • Can sniff out backlink opportunities and content gaps with ease.
  • Think like a strategist, not just a technician—you care about rankings and ROI.
  • Bring ideas, not excuses.


What success looks like:

  • Rankings rise, traffic grows, and leads actually turn into sales.
  • Client sites are fast, optimized, and hitting Google’s performance benchmarks.
  • Clients say, “SEO is the best investment we’ve ever made.”
  • You use AI + automation to work smarter, not harder.
  • You level up through direct exposure to world-class SEO mentorship.


About Us – BestLyfe Group

We’re not your average agency. We mix creativity with conversion strategy, and marketing theory with get-it-done execution. Our team is stacked with marketers, ex-military leaders, entrepreneurs, and a shared obsession for making our clients look like absolute legends in their space.

We’ve helped double revenue for our clients, from home improvement companies to entertainment brands. We’re real, scrappy, and sharp as hell.


Perks & Culture

  • Remote-first team with a local presence in Atlanta
  • Access to cutting-edge AI, automation, and SEO tools
  • Routine access to a world-class SEO mentor + his team
  • Collaborative, fast-moving environment that values ownership and execution
  • No micromanagement, no corporate BS—just excellence, results, and some laughs along the way


Compensation

$2,000 - $2,500/month


Ready to apply?

Apply on LinkedIn and then send me ( ):

  • SEO case studies or proof of wins (rankings, traffic, conversions)
  • Your favorite SEO victory (and why it mattered)
  • A short note on why you’re the right fit
  • Your CV and LinkedIn profile


Make it count—we only hire top performers who want to grow with us. If that’s you, I want to hear from you.

P.S. If I think you’re a strong fit, I’ll send you a quick video screener invite so we can get acquainted.


— Dustin Lunde

CEO, BestLyfe Group

title: Strategic Executive Assistant to the CEO
description:
The Vision


At AI Leadership, we believe in clarity, structure, and well-run operations that allow our team to focus on the work that creates the greatest impact. The Strategic EA role exists to provide end-to-end leverage to the CEO by owning tactical and operational execution: inbox, calendar, logistics, and meeting prep. We are looking for a \"thinking partner\" who can maintain the highest standards of operational excellence and brand representation.


Who We’re Looking For


The Strategic Executive Assistant (EA) will act as the CEO's \"20% focus\" unlock, allowing him to drive 80% of business outcomes. This is not a role for someone who only follows rigid rules; we need an individual who can operate with nuance, anticipate needs before they are stated, and understand the CEO's unique decision-making framework.

You will be measured on your ability to triage the CEO's inbox to 95% without escalation and reduce calendar friction to near-zero. If you are a high-nuance individual who \"just gets it\" and thrives in a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.



Why You Should Join Us


  • AI Frontier : Gain direct exposure to the AI space and learn to build and refine AI-driven automation.
  • Career Growth : We are a growing organization that values internal mobility; this role has a path toward operations or management, as demonstrated by previous incumbents.
  • High-Impact Environment : Work alongside experienced leaders who prioritize growth, ambition, and proactive problem-solving.


Role Responsibilities


The 20% That Drives 80% of Success

  • Inbox Ownership : Manage the CEO's inbox end-to-end, responding to all messages within 24 hours using his tone and zero \"emotional leakage\".
  • Strategic Calendar Defense : Own the calendar to ensure it reflects strategic priorities; proactively identify gaps or blockers and coordinate with the family assistant to honor personal time.
  • Flawless Travel & Logistics : Execute end-to-end travel (flights, hotels, ground transport) and remain on-call for any transit issues.
  • Meeting Readiness : Maintain prep docs and ensure the CEO is fully prepared for every internal and external stakeholder interaction.

The Remaining 80%

  • HubSpot & CRM Maintenance : Review deals weekly, ensure follow-up tasks are executed on time, and load new contacts sourced by the CEO.
  • SOP & Notion Management : Fully own and update all CEO-related workflows and databases, ensuring documentation is audit-ready and searchable.
  • Small-Scope Project Management : Lead projects assigned by the Exec Ops Manager, assessing needs, developing plans, and communicating status to stakeholders.


Skills & Attributes We're Looking For


  • Methodical & Nuanced : You understand the difference between tactical execution and strategic decision-making and can operate independently in ambiguous situations.
  • 1–3 Years of Relevant Experience : Ideally supporting senior leaders or working in high-growth, corporate, or communications-heavy environments.
  • Proactive Tech-Savviness : Proficiency with Google Workspace, Slack, HubSpot (or similar CRMs), and Notion, plus a strong drive to use AI tools for speed and efficiency.
  • Executive Presence : You have a professional audio/video setup and communicate with the polish required for CEO-facing interactions.
  • Coachability : You believe feedback is the \"breakfast of champions\" and iterate quickly based on guidance.


Our Values


  • Create remarkable experiences – Every interaction is a chance to satisfy customers and internal team members.
  • Always be growing – Committed to continuous improvement and individual learning.
  • Deliver results – Taking initiative to solve problems and drive success regardless of formal responsibility.
  • Do the right thing – Prioritizing integrity, respect, and discretion in all interactions.
  • Practice what we teach – Pushing the boundaries of what it means to be AI-driven.

Compensation & Location


  • Compensation : Starts at $2,200 USD
  • Location : Remote (Working within 8 AM - 5 PM CST is preferred).


Application & Selection Process


TO APPLY:

  • Send your Resume (PDF titled \"Lastname.Firstname.EA.pdf\") to (Operations+ ).
  • Record a short demo video (2 - 4 mins max) highlighting your relevant experience for the role, skills, successes, and goals for the future. Also, we’d like you to briefly mention the following insights: Process Optimization Proposal: Share an example of how you’ve improved an operational workflow in the past (Preferably using AI or automation tools). We want you to showcase your personality, and why you believe you are the ideal candidate for the Strategic Executive Assistant role.


Our process is thorough but rewarding. Here is what you can expect:

  • Technical AI Prompt Test and Strategic Thinking Exercise
  • Behavioral Assessments : Working Genius (to assess natural strengths) and Kolbe A Index.

Three-Step Interview sequence : Initial Screening call → Head of Operations → CEO.

title: Remote Business Analyst (Portuguese) - 54880
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and Portuguese)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles



Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Data Architect
description:
Job Title: Data Architect

Duration: 6months

Location: LATAM (Remote)

Need to support PST timings


Description:

What You’ll Do

Design & Strategy: Develop and maintain the overall data architecture aligned with organizational strategy.

Blueprint Creation: Create conceptual, logical, and physical data models to support data storage, processing, and consumption needs.

Cross‑Functional Collaboration: Partner with business and technical stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable data solutions.

Governance & Security: Define and enforce data governance, data quality, and security standards across all data systems.

Technology Selection: Evaluate and select cloud platforms, storage solutions, and data processing tools appropriate for enterprise needs.

Implementation Leadership: Oversee the delivery of data pipelines, data warehouses, data lakes, and APIs.

Performance Optimization: Ensure high performance, scalability, and reliability across all data systems.


Key Skills

  • Modern Data Modelling: Expertise with dbt modelling approaches and Snowflake‑optimized schemas (e.g., Star Schema, Data Vault).
  • Snowflake Architecture: Strong knowledge of virtual warehouses, scaling, clustering, and storage optimization.
  • Airflow Orchestration: Ability to design and manage complex Airflow DAGs.
  • Advanced SQL & Python: Expertise in transforming, processing, and orchestrating data.
  • AWS Infrastructure: Hands‑on experience with S3, IAM, and Private Link for secure and efficient data access.
  • ELT Strategy: Skilled in building ELT pipelines using tools like Fivetran and dbt.


Preferred Skills

  • Active Metadata & Governance (Atlan)
  • BI Semantic Layering
  • Data Mesh & Data Contracts
  • FinOps & Cost Governance
  • CI/CD for Data Pipelines

title: Senior Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required ⚠️


About Foundey


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.

description:
Are you a detail-driven professional with experience in security and low-voltage system design and estimating? UTS Group is expanding our technical team and we want to hear from you.


UTS Group is a leading North American security integration company serving clients across Canada and the U.S. We specialize in Access Control, CCTV, Intercom, Door Hardware, Automatic Doors, and full low-voltage infrastructure. We are looking for a Security & Low-Voltage Designer / Estimator who can review drawings, analyze tenders, design system layouts, and prepare accurate cost estimates for complex projects.


This is a remote, full-time role, working Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time (ET).

⸻

Position Overview

This hybrid role blends design and estimating. You will review construction drawings, bids, and tender packages, then translate them into complete design documents, material takeoffs, and competitive estimates. You’ll prepare layouts, risers, and technical specifications using AutoCAD and Bluebeam, while collaborating with project managers, sales teams, and vendors to ensure accuracy and compliance.

⸻

Key Responsibilities

• Review and interpret technical drawings, floor plans, door schedules, and tender documents

• Design integrated security systems (CCTV, Access Control, Intrusion, Intercom)

• Design low-voltage/data systems including structured cabling, network racks, and pathways

• Prepare material take-offs (MTO), labour estimates, and detailed cost proposals

• Produce layouts, risers, and markups using AutoCAD and Bluebeam

• Develop and submit accurate quotations and bid packages

• Collaborate with sales, PMs, and vendors to confirm pricing, timelines, and compatibility

• Maintain organized records of estimates, proposals, drawings, and documentation

• Participate in handover meetings for awarded projects

• Contribute to continuous improvement of estimating templates and design standards

• 2–3+ years of experience in security system estimating or low-voltage design

• Proven ability to read and interpret construction drawings and tender documents

• Strong proficiency with AutoCAD and Bluebeam Revu

• Solid understanding of low-voltage systems, wiring methods, and structured cabling standards (TIA/EIA)

• Experience with quoting Access Control, CCTV, Intercom, Door Hardware, and related systems

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills

• Proficiency with Office 365 (Excel, Outlook, Word)

• Ability to work remotely with strong self-management and organization

• Experience with Zoho CRM/Books or similar platforms is an asset

⸻

Nice to Have

• Education in Engineering, Architecture, Technology, or related fields

• Knowledge of Canadian and U.S. security/building codes

• Experience preparing technical submittals or shop drawings

• French language proficiency

⸻

Work Details

• Type: Full-time

• Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM ET

description:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer (LATAM Only)
description:
Senior Full Stack Software Engineer

Location: Remote — Brazil/US time zones (EST ±3h) • Contract: International contractor, $35/hour • Language: English (fluent) • Reports to: CTO & Engineering team.



About the role

Volatus is hiring a Senior Fullstack Engineer to own critical product work on a next‑generation platform for fertility clinics and their patients. You will join as a founding engineer, shaping both the product and the technical direction in a category where better software directly improves patient outcomes.


Tech context

You will work in a modern, greenfield stack centered on:

  • Frontend: Next.js/React , Typescript , Tailwind CSS
  • Backend: Node.js/TypeScript with a PostgreSQL core (schema design, authN,authZ, performance, transactions, triggers).
  • Data & integrations: Third-party API integrations ; performance profiling (e.g., Lighthouse).
  • Quality: Unit, integration, and end-to-end tests; CI/CD .
  • Collaboration: Work closely with our Head of Engineering, Principal Engineer, Product Designer, and CEO.


What you will do

  • Build and ship end‑to‑end features across the Next.js frontend and Node/TypeScript backend. 
  • Model and tune Postgres schemas; ensure secure authN/authZ and strong performance. 
  • Integrate external APIs and improve app reliability and speed (including Lighthouse‑driven improvements). 
  • Write reliable tests (unit/integration/e2e) and contribute to CI/CD workflows. 
  • Make pragmatic early‑stage architectural decisions and raise the engineering bar.


What you will bring

  • Proficiency with AI tools to accelerate development and quality. 
  • Strong production experience with Next.js/React, Node.js, and TypeScript.
  • Tailwind & CSS mastery; responsive, accessible UI. 
  • PostgreSQL expertise (modeling, security/auth, performance, transactions, triggers). 
  • Integrations experience (third‑party APIs) and solid testing practice (unit/integration/e2e). 
  • Portfolio or links to shipped projects/code.


90-day outcomes

In your first 90 days, you will:

  • Lead at least one significant feature from design to production, used by real clinics or internal teams.​
  • Improve a key part of the frontend experience (e.g., performance, usability, or design consistency) and document the standards for others.​
  • Own part of the backend or data model, including at least one meaningful performance or reliability improvement.​
  • Help define or refine testing and deployment practices so the team can ship faster and with more confidence.


Nice to have

  • Experience building voice‑controlled components / speech‑to‑text. 
  • Experience interacting with AI models from the web app.


How we work

  • Remote within EST ±3 hours preferred ; open to other time zones if you can collaborate on US‑friendly hours.
  • Small, senior team with a strong bias toward action and ownership ;
  • Product-led culture : engineers are closely involved in discovery, tradeoff discussions, and shaping the roadmap.


Hiring process

  • Coderpad Challenge (60 min)
  • Intro chat (45 min) – mutual fit and role context.
  • Technical deep‑dive & Live testing – discuss systems you’ve built; pair on a focused problem (no whiteboard trivia).
  • Team conversation – meet engineering + product leadership.
  • References & offer.


Volatus is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.

title: Cientista de Dados SR
description:
A Atos é líder global em transformação digital, com 112 mil colaboradores em 73 países e receita anual de €12 bilhões. Há mais de 30 anos no Brasil conectando pessoas, negócios e tecnologia para ajudar a melhorar o mundo em que vivemos.


Perfil da Vaga:

Buscamos um(a) Cientista de Dados para atuar em projetos estratégicos de inovação, integrando inteligência artificial, ciência de dados e pesquisa aplicada ao desenvolvimento de soluções na indústria química.


Contratação: Cooperado

Duração: 12 meses (com possibilidade de renovação)


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver modelos preditivos e redes neurais aplicados aos projetos.
  • Criar e manter documentação estatística e técnica.
  • Utilizar algoritmos de machine learning, deep learning e análise estatística.
  • Realizar coleta, limpeza, enriquecimento, estruturação e validação de dados.
  • Executar análises exploratórias baseadas em inferência estatística para identificação de padrões e insights relevantes.
  • Atuar com modelagem preditiva, segmentação e análise de anomalias.
  • Desenvolver estudos de caso com análise descritiva.
  • Aplicar conceitos de matemática, estatística e aprendizado de máquina no desenvolvimento das soluções.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência com linguagens e ferramentas: R, Python, SPSS e SAS .
  • Conhecimento em machine learning, deep learning e redes neurais .
  • Experiência em ambientes on-premises e/ou cloud .
  • Sólida base em matemática e estatística aplicada .



Entendemos a diversidade como um fator valioso. Por isso, independentemente da sua identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, etnia, idade, deficiência, cidadania ou qualquer outro aspecto que o torne único, inscreva-se!

title: Founding Application Engineer (Agentic AI)
description:
ABOUT VOX

VOX is an Agentic Market Research platform that is Introducing a new model in Market Research. We’re turning Buyer-Sourced Insights into Real-Time Revenue, directly tackling the critical need for precise, timely, and relevant buyer data.


Our solution moves beyond traditional methods by utilizing human-led research powered by AI to provide real-time, human-validated insights.


ABOUT THE ROLE

You will own and scale VOX’s engineering organization as we enter our next phase of growth. As a founding engineer, you’ll define the technical vision, architect the core product, and partner closely with leadership to build an AI-native platform—leveraging agentic AI systems to scale subject-matter expertise.


This role is ideal for someone excited to build from zero to one, operate with high ownership, and shape both the product and the engineering culture from the ground up.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Architect and Build

  • Design and implement VOX’s initial product architecture and tech stack from scratch.
  • Build and iterate on MVPs with a strong bias toward speed, learning, and scalability.
  • Architect AI-first systems, including agent-based workflows that reason, plan, and act autonomously.


Agentic AI Development

  • Design, build, and deploy agentic AI systems (e.g., LLM-powered agents, tool-using agents, multi-agent workflows).
  • Integrate AI agents with product features such as expert reasoning, decision support, orchestration, and automation.
  • Evaluate and optimize models, prompts, tools, and feedback loops for reliability, performance, and cost.


Full-Stack Development

  • Work across the full stack—frontend, backend, data, and infrastructure.
  • Build APIs, services, and data pipelines that support AI-driven workflows and real-time interactions.


Product & Technical Strategy

  • Collaborate closely with founders and early customers to define product requirements and roadmap.
  • Translate ambiguous problems into shipped features, iterating rapidly based on real-world feedback.
  • Make pragmatic trade-offs between speed, quality, and scalability in an early-stage environment.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Technical Expertise

  • Strong software engineering background with proficiency in languages such as Python and JavaScript.
  • Experience with databases (SQL/NoSQL), APIs, and cloud platforms (AWS or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with modern AI/ML tooling (e.g., LLM APIs, vector databases, orchestration frameworks).


Agentic AI & Systems Thinking

  • Hands-on experience building or experimenting with agentic AI systems, autonomous workflows, or LLM-powered applications.
  • Strong understanding of system design, reliability, and failure modes in AI-driven products.
  • Ability to reason about trade-offs in model selection, latency, cost, and accuracy.


Problem-Solving & Product Mindset

  • Exceptional problem-solving skills and comfort operating in ambiguity.
  • Strong product intuition with a deep focus on user experience and business impact.


Communication & Ownership

  • Excellent communication skills, able to bridge technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • High degree of ownership, autonomy, and adaptability in a fast-moving startup environment.



* Competitive base salary plus meaningful equity.

description:

title: Founding Application Engineer (Agentic AI)
description:
ABOUT VOX

VOX is an Agentic Market Research platform that is Introducing a new model in Market Research. We’re turning Buyer-Sourced Insights into Real-Time Revenue, directly tackling the critical need for precise, timely, and relevant buyer data.


Our solution moves beyond traditional methods by utilizing human-led research powered by AI to provide real-time, human-validated insights.


ABOUT THE ROLE

You will own and scale VOX’s engineering organization as we enter our next phase of growth. As a founding engineer, you’ll define the technical vision, architect the core product, and partner closely with leadership to build an AI-native platform—leveraging agentic AI systems to scale subject-matter expertise.


This role is ideal for someone excited to build from zero to one, operate with high ownership, and shape both the product and the engineering culture from the ground up.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Architect and Build

  • Design and implement VOX’s initial product architecture and tech stack from scratch.
  • Build and iterate on MVPs with a strong bias toward speed, learning, and scalability.
  • Architect AI-first systems, including agent-based workflows that reason, plan, and act autonomously.


Agentic AI Development

  • Design, build, and deploy agentic AI systems (e.g., LLM-powered agents, tool-using agents, multi-agent workflows).
  • Integrate AI agents with product features such as expert reasoning, decision support, orchestration, and automation.
  • Evaluate and optimize models, prompts, tools, and feedback loops for reliability, performance, and cost.


Full-Stack Development

  • Work across the full stack—frontend, backend, data, and infrastructure.
  • Build APIs, services, and data pipelines that support AI-driven workflows and real-time interactions.


Product & Technical Strategy

  • Collaborate closely with founders and early customers to define product requirements and roadmap.
  • Translate ambiguous problems into shipped features, iterating rapidly based on real-world feedback.
  • Make pragmatic trade-offs between speed, quality, and scalability in an early-stage environment.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Technical Expertise

  • Strong software engineering background with proficiency in languages such as Python and JavaScript.
  • Experience with databases (SQL/NoSQL), APIs, and cloud platforms (AWS or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with modern AI/ML tooling (e.g., LLM APIs, vector databases, orchestration frameworks).


Agentic AI & Systems Thinking

  • Hands-on experience building or experimenting with agentic AI systems, autonomous workflows, or LLM-powered applications.
  • Strong understanding of system design, reliability, and failure modes in AI-driven products.
  • Ability to reason about trade-offs in model selection, latency, cost, and accuracy.


Problem-Solving & Product Mindset

  • Exceptional problem-solving skills and comfort operating in ambiguity.
  • Strong product intuition with a deep focus on user experience and business impact.


Communication & Ownership

  • Excellent communication skills, able to bridge technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • High degree of ownership, autonomy, and adaptability in a fast-moving startup environment.



* Competitive base salary plus meaningful equity.

description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em um grupo eleito como a 86ª startup mais promissora do Brasil ?


A Conface Contabilidade , empresa da Dreamland Holding (que também inclui a Dream Success), está em busca de um(a) Analista Contábil Fiscal para integrar o time.


Essa é uma oportunidade para contadores que desejam crescer em uma contabilidade reconhecida pelo modelo inovador e por um atendimento verdadeiramente humanizado .


Para nós, contabilidade não é apenas enviar tributos para o cliente todos os meses. É fazer parte da vida do empreendedor , ajudando-o a crescer e tomar decisões estratégicas.


Responsabilidades (Fiscal & Contábil)


  • Apuração de impostos : ISS, ICMS, IPI, IRPJ, CSLL, PIS e COFINS.
  • Obrigações acessórias : EFD ICMS/IPI, EFD Contribuições, ECD , ECF, DCTF, EFD-Reinf e DEFIS (e DIRF quando exigida pela legislação vigente).
  • Acompanhamento das mudanças do IVA (Imposto sobre Valor Adicionado) que passam a vigorar a partir do próximo ano.
  • Fechamento contábil autônomo : conciliações, provisões, classificação contábil, balancetes, Balanço e DRE .
  • Relatórios gerenciais e indicadores das empresas da carteira.

Requisitos


  • Graduação em Ciências Contábeis (concluída ou em andamento).
  • CRC ativo (obrigatório e deve constar no currículo enviado para conferência ).
  • Experiência anterior na função fiscal/contábil em escritório de contabilidade.
  • Conhecimento de Lucro Real, Lucro Presumido e Simples Nacional .
  • Domínio do Pacote Office (principalmente Excel ).
  • Sistema Domínio : conhecimento prático e comprovado (eliminatório).
  • Organização, atenção a detalhes, senso de dono e comunicação clara em ambiente remoto.


Nossa cultura


Aqui, trabalho é esforço, resultado e entrega .

Valorizamos profissionais que desejam ter direitos respeitados , mas que também entendem que nossa empresa preza por meritocracia e comprometimento .


Não seguimos a chamada “cultura do mimimi”.

Acreditamos em um ambiente justo, com reconhecimento proporcional ao desempenho , onde quem se dedica, cresce.


Benefícios


  • Vaga 100% remota — Acreditamos de verdade no Home Office. Mas com monitoramento de performance por metas e entregas claras. Utilizamos um programa chamado Jibble, para controle de trabalho remoto.
  • Gestão humanizada — Valorizamos a diversidade e quem você é ️‍ . Para nós humanização começa com quem está aqui dentro.
  • Day-off no aniversário — Aproveite seu dia para comemorar.
  • Feedbacks trimestrais estruturados através do nosso Comitê de Pessoas — Significa que você tem chance real de ser promovido a cada 3 meses , conforme seu desempenho.
  • Caju Benefícios Flexíveis — Disponibilizamos R$500 por mês para você utilizar em benefícios flexíveis.
  • Rapidoc — Acesso ao maior hub de saúde corporativa digital do Brasil. Disponibilizamos para você e 3 familiares pago 100% pela nossa empresa.
  • Treinamento e desenvolvimento — Investimos no seu crescimento com cursos pagos pela empresa.
  • Adicional no salário caso utilize equipamentos próprios para trabalho remoto — Afinal respeitamos seus equipamentos próprios e vamos te pagar pela utilização dos mesmos, caso necessário.


Como se candidatar


Candidate-se pelo LinkedIn e mantenha seu currículo atualizado .

É obrigatório que o número do CRC ativo conste no currículo para validação.


Caso possua, anexe certificações e destaque projetos/rotinas relevantes (fechamento contábil, ECD/ECF, apuração de tributos, acompanhamento de legislação e uso do Sistema Domínio).


Nosso processo seletivo será feito em 4 fases com previsão de contratação ainda neste mês de Outubro/25.


Venha construir sua carreira com a gente e fazer parte de um time que está transformando o futuro da contabilidade e das empresas!

title: Analista de desenvolvimento de software
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições

O dia a dia:

  • Disseminar conhecimento e documentar decisões técnicas, por meio da criação de documentos ou registros no sistema de gestão.
  • Promover boas práticas de desenvolvimento, qualidade de código e testes automatizados, por meio de capacitações, compartilhamento de informações e registros.

  • Apoiar outros times de Engenharia, garantindo que grandes lançamentos e mudanças tecnológicas ocorram de forma segura, minimizando impactos.
